sections.title: Living and Non-living Things
sections.explanation: Living things grow, need food, water and air, and can respond. Non-living things do not grow or need food. Sort objects at home and school.
points: Living: plant, cat, bird, fish, humans
Non-living: chair, toy car, stone, pencil

steps: It does not grow or eat

sections.title: Plants Around Us
sections.explanation: Plants are living. Roots, stem, leaves, flowers and fruits have jobs. Plants need sunlight, air, water and soil.
points: Flowers lead to fruits and seeds
Trees are tall and woody; herbs are small; climbers need support

sections.title: Animals and Their Food
sections.explanation: Animals move to find food. Herbivores eat plants, carnivores eat meat, omnivores eat both.
points: Pets need food, water, love and a clean place

sections.title: Our Body and Senses
sections.explanation: Our body helps us play and learn. Five senses tell us about the world. Bones support; muscles help us move.
points: Eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, skin touches
Wash hands, brush teeth, bathe, sleep well
Exercise and play keep us strong

sections.title: Food We Eat
sections.explanation: Food gives energy to study and play. Eat energy foods, body-building foods and protective foods. Drink clean water.
points: Do not waste food; wash fruits before eating

sections.title: Houses and Clothes
sections.explanation: Houses keep us safe from heat, cold, rain and animals. Clothes protect us and match the weather.

sections.title: Water, Air and Weather
sections.explanation: Clean air and water keep us healthy. Weather can be sunny, rainy, windy or cloudy. Save water.
points: Uses of water: drink, cook, bathe, clean

sections.title: Day, Night and Seasons
sections.explanation: The Sun gives light and heat by day. Night is dark. Seasons include summer, winter and rainy season.
points: Summer is hot; winter is cold; rainy season is wet

sections.title: Materials Around Us
sections.explanation: Things are made of wood, metal, plastic, glass, rubber or cloth. Choose the right material for the job.

sections.title: Health, Hygiene and Safety
sections.explanation: Good habits keep germs away. Follow safety rules at home, on the road and at school.
points: Cross at zebra crossing with an adult
Do not play with fire, sharp things or medicines
